provenance.note: No parent pair was supplied with this score.

manifest.seal: Proposed seal, not canon: two roots, an open interval, and a return left unfinished. No fusion.

operator_instances.title: The Double Root
operator_instances.meaning: Two sources stay identifiable. Two marks are not two people and not a quarrel.

operator_instances.title: The Held Interval
operator_instances.meaning: A measured gap: ache, pause, or what has not yet been decided. It is not a connection.

operator_instances.title: The Unfinished Return
operator_instances.meaning: Coming back changed. The arc stays open. It is not a rewind to the same state.

operator_instances.title: The Bounded Aperture
operator_instances.meaning: An inquiry left unclosed. Completeness of this moment is not an answer to everything.

operator_instances.title: The Witness Offset
operator_instances.meaning: Observation with a bounded scope. Seeing is not contact and not agreement.

operator_instances.title: The Countertrace
operator_instances.meaning: A counterreading: a risk the upright text warns against. It has not been established as fact.
operator_instances.meaning_quote_span: The reflection has become more precious than the one it reflects. One participant may demand permanent confirmation, or use the beauty of a shared symbol to refuse correction. Anot

legend.intro: Codex of Becoming is a new visual grammar for this installation. It is not original canon, not a historical occult system, and not a claim that these shapes were already in the 78. A painted glimmer is not a join. Only a listed CONTACT mark is a stored meeting.
legend.contact_note: No CONTACT glyph. The stored graph did not authenticate a join, so none was drawn.
legend.seal: Proposed seal, not canon: two roots, an open interval, and a return left unfinished. No fusion.
